B. The Fourteenth Amendment is unclear. (Both cases discuss unclear; but not the main message).
C. With the conclusion of Roe v. Wade, the right to abortion was largely recognized by society. (This states that after Roe the right was recognized; implies societal acceptance? It's somewhat true but incomplete.)

So D is incorrect.
